message.reasoning_content:
The kernel uses A&S erf approximation with absolute error ~1e-7 in erf... GELU requires abs error ≤ 1e-6. A&S 7.1.26 has erf error < 1.5e-7, but Phi error ~7.5e-8. x*Phi error ~ |x|*7.5e-8 — for |x|~10 that's 7.5e-7... near zero error may exceed 1e-6 for large |x|? Actually for large x, GELU ≈ x, and error is x*Phi_err. Phi err 7.5e-8 relative... Let's just run a probe over a dense set of FP16 values (all 65536 finite ones can't be enumerated easily? Actually 65536 values is enumerable!) and compare with erfc reference.

Claim: A&S approximation's error exceeds 1e-6 for some finite FP16 inputs. Record claim and run probe over all finite FP16 values.
